title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, shares jump 31%
caption:
Nvidia's board has unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive, 11 days after he resigned amid reports linking him to a woman suspected of spying for China, which Beijing denies. President Trump had pushed for his return. Nvidia shares closed up more than 31% on Monday. An independent board committee is still investigating, and Nvidia says it will keep cooperating with government inquiries.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
